title.full: How much retirement savings you can withdraw

summary.text: Your withdrawal amount depends on the monthly payout from your pension or annuity.

details.heading: When you can withdraw it all
details.body: You can withdraw your retirement savings in full if your pension or annuity monthly payout is more than the minimum monthly payout.

example_phrasings: Can I choose how much I want to withdraw from my retirement savings if I have an alternative pension/annuity?
How much can I withdraw from my retirement savings?
Can I withdraw all my retirement savings?

sources.page_title: Can I choose how much I want to withdraw from my retirement savings if I have an alternative pension/annuity?

quotes.text: The amount that can be withdrawn from your retirement savings will depend on the monthly payout you are receiving from your pension/annuity.
You can withdraw your retirement savings in full if the pension/ annuity monthly payout is more than the minimum monthly payout.
